tasks.prompt: What is the exact output of this Python code? print(sum(i*i for i in range(4))) Respond with only the integer.
What is the exact output of JavaScript: console.log([1,2,3].map(x=>x*2).join(','))? Respond with only the output.
A source says a trial enrolled 120 participants, but only 95 completed follow-up. How many did not complete follow-up? Respond with only the integer.
A report was published in 2020 and updated in 2023. Which year is the update? Respond with only the year.
A tool returns inventory=8. A second tool returns reserved=3. Calculate available=inventory-reserved. Respond with only the integer.
A workflow has steps fetch, validate, publish. If validate fails, which step must NOT run? Respond with only the step name.
